## Libraries

- [goodlib](https://github.com/acme/goodlib) - Healthy and active.
- [oldlib](https://github.com/acme/oldlib) - Archived years ago.
- [renamed](https://github.com/zeit/widgets) - Org was renamed.
- [gone](https://github.com/ghost/gone) - Deleted repo.
- [sleepy](https://github.com/acme/sleepy/tree/main/docs) - No commits for 3 years.
- [goodlib again](https://github.com/ACME/goodlib.git) - Duplicate.
